name: FeltOS ecology: resource stock and pollution read by formula from the last harvest or pollution, not written per tick
asks: write the FeltOS ecology law you stopped before, which replaces the per-tick stock and pollution writes with a formula read from when each resource was last harvested or polluted (FeltOS ecology.mjs and gathering.mjs plus their tests, and Farstone's climate and perception)

x-provenance.recorded-by: Red Cup Engineer Senior, pass farstone-ksp-1 of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus

sources.words: write the FeltOS ecology law you stopped before, which replaces the per-tick stock and pollution writes with a formula read from when each resource was last harvested or polluted (FeltOS ecology.mjs and gathering.mjs plus their tests, and Farstone's climate and perception)

requirements.rationale: The Leader's ecology law: no per-tick stock or pollution writes.
requirements.says: FeltOS shall record, for each resource, only the time and amount of its last harvest and its last pollution event.

requirements.rationale: 'a formula read from when each resource was last harvested or polluted'.
requirements.says: FeltOS shall derive a resource's stock and pollution at any time by a closed-form rate law evaluated from its last recorded event.

requirements.rationale: Per-tick writes are what the law replaces; idle world time is owed and paid by evaluation.
requirements.says: FeltOS shall write no ecology state on a world tick in which no resource is harvested or polluted.

requirements.rationale: The order names Farstone's climate and perception as consumers.
requirements.says: Farstone's climate and perception shall read resource stock and pollution through the FeltOS ecology law.

requirements.rationale: The order names ecology.mjs and gathering.mjs.
requirements.says: FeltOS's gathering shall record a harvest as an ecology event of the law in R1.
